content:
wild flower blossoming
I beg of you
tell me this so I know too
Why do people fight
they all act as if it is right
so they know thats no way to live

Valiant flower blossoming 
What can you see 
when you look down on me

why can't people see
that they are sorry for the way
that they fought
I thought
We once could

When the sky has cleared and rain
Has passed
I still won't forget the past
You would not alone on your own

I remember you back then
Trembling in front of me
crying deep inside silently

When you see loved ones withering 
What do you do with your remaining time 
When your leaves can't speak a word
And your thoughts cannot be heard
How do you convey your love 

AH~~

When the summer's sun is hiding in
and winds are harsh against our backs
everything seems to be overlap

I'll sing in your memory 
all the time you have (spent) on me 
we have lost your name but I'll sing for you
听过的最好的反常版本。
